name: Jan Schakowsky
stance: Opposes federal preemption of state AI laws and backs strong oversight of AI companies, including in trade agreements.

statements.text: Urged House Republicans to vote against the reconciliation bill containing the moratorium on state AI regulation.
There’s a reason attempts to block state AI protections keep failing in Congress: they’re unpopular, undemocratic, and dangerous.
Big Tech shouldn't get to write the rules for global AI. That's why I joined @SenWarren in urging the Trump Administration to stand up for strong oversight of AI companies.
